segments.contextBefore: **Be mindful that custom gestures aren’t always accessible.** When VoiceOver is turned on in visionOS, apps and games that define custom gestures don’t receive hand input by default.
segments.contextAfter: A person can opt out of this behavior by enabling Direct Gesture mode, which disables standard VoiceOver gestures and lets apps process hand input directly.
